name: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant - Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth Quotes

quotes.quote:
Making money is not a thing you do—it’s a skill you learn.
赚钱不是一件想做就能做的事情，而是一门需要学习的技能。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Building Wealth

quotes.quote:
Seek wealth, not money or status. Wealth is having assets that earn while you sleep. Money is how we transfer time and wealth. Status is your place in the social hierarchy.
追求财富，而不是金钱或地位。财富是指在你睡觉时仍能为你赚钱的资产。金钱是我们转换时间和财富的方式。地位是你在社会等级体系中所处的位置。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

quotes.quote:
Understand ethical wealth creation is possible. If you secretly despise wealth, it will elude you.
创造财富和坚持道德标准是可以兼得的。如果你内心鄙视财富，财富就会对你避而远之。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

quotes.quote:
Ignore people playing status games. They gain status by attacking people playing wealth creation games.
无视一味追求社会地位的人。他们获得地位的手段就是攻击创造财富的人。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

quotes.quote:
You’re not going to get rich renting out your time. You must own equity—a piece of a business—to gain your financial freedom.
依靠出租时间是不可能致富的。你必须拥有股权（企业的部分所有权），才能实现财务自由。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

quotes.quote:
You will get rich by giving society what it wants but does not yet know how to get. At scale.
获得财富的一个途径，就是为社会提供其有需求但无从获得的东西，并实现规模化。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

quotes.quote:
Pick an industry where you can play long-term games with long-term people.
选择一个有长期发展前景的行业，找到可以长期合作的人。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Play Long-Term Games with Long-Term People

quotes.quote:
The internet has massively broadened the possible space of careers. Most people haven’t figured this out yet.
互联网极大地拓展了职业空间，但大多数人还没有清晰地认识到这一点。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

quotes.quote:
Play iterated games. All the returns in life, whether in wealth, relationships, or knowledge, come from compound interest.
培养迭代思维。生活中所有的回报，无论是财富、人际关系，还是知识，都来自复利。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Play Long-Term Games with Long-Term People

quotes.quote:
Pick business partners with high intelligence, energy, and, above all, integrity.
选择聪明过人、精力充沛的商业伙伴，但更重要的是，他们要正直诚信。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Play Long-Term Games with Long-Term People

quotes.quote:
Don’t partner with cynics and pessimists. Their beliefs are self-fulfilling.
不要跟愤世嫉俗和消极悲观的人合作。他们的预言会自我实现。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Play Long-Term Games with Long-Term People

quotes.quote:
Learn to sell. Learn to build. If you can do both, you will be unstoppable.
学会销售，学会构建，两技傍身，势不可当。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Building Wealth

quotes.quote:
Arm yourself with specific knowledge, accountability, and leverage.
用专长、责任感和杠杆效应武装自己。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
Specific knowledge is knowledge you cannot be trained for. If society can train you, it can train someone else and replace you.
专长指的是无法通过培训获得的知识。如果社会可以培训你，那么社会也可以培训他人来取代你。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
Specific knowledge is found by pursuing your genuine curiosity and passion rather than whatever is hot right now.
要想有所专长，就要追求真正的兴趣和热爱，而不是盲目追逐热点。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
Building specific knowledge will feel like play to you but will look like work to others.
累积专长的过程，对你而言就像玩耍，对他人来说则很吃力。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
Specific knowledge is often highly technical or creative. It cannot be outsourced or automated.
专长往往具有高度的技术性或创造性，不能被外包或自动化。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
Embrace accountability, and take business risks under your own name. Society will reward you with responsibility, equity, and leverage.
培养责任感，勇于以个人名义承担商业风险。社会将根据责任大小、股权多少和杠杆效应回报你。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Take on Accountability

quotes.quote:
Fortunes require leverage. Business leverage comes from capital, people, and products with no marginal cost of replication (code and media).
要想获得财富，就必须充分利用杠杆效应。商业杠杆来自资本、劳动力和复制边际成本为零的产品（代码和媒体）。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find a Position of Leverage

quotes.quote:
Capital means money. To raise money, apply your specific knowledge with accountability and show resulting good judgment.
资本是指金钱。要想获得融资，需要运用自己的专长和责任感，并表现出良好的判断力。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find a Position of Leverage

quotes.quote:
Labor means people working for you. It’s the oldest and most fought-over form of leverage. Labor leverage will impress your parents, but don’t waste your life chasing it.
劳动力杠杆就是让别人为你工作。这是最古老、争夺最激烈的一种杠杆。拥有劳动力杠杆会让你的父母觉得你很了不起，但不要过度追逐劳动力杠杆。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find a Position of Leverage

quotes.quote:
Code and media are permissionless leverage. They’re the leverage behind the newly rich. You can create software and media that works for you while you sleep.
代码和媒体是不需要许可就能使用的杠杆。这两个杠杆是新富阶层背后的杠杆。你可以创建软件和媒体，让它们在你睡觉时为你工作。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find a Position of Leverage

quotes.quote:
If you can’t code, write books and blogs, record videos and podcasts.
如果你不会写代码，那就出书、写博客、做视频、录播客。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find a Position of Leverage

quotes.quote:
Leverage is a force multiplier for your judgment.
杠杆是判断力的倍增器。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find a Position of Leverage

quotes.quote:
There is no skill called “business.” Avoid business magazines and business classes.
没有所谓的“商业”技能。不要把时间浪费在商业杂志和商业课程上。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Prioritize and Focus

quotes.quote:
Study microeconomics, game theory, psychology, persuasion, ethics, mathematics, and computers.
学习微观经济学、博弈论、心理学、说服术、伦理学、数学和计算机。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Prioritize and Focus

quotes.quote:
Reading is faster than listening. Doing is faster than watching.
读比听快，做比看快。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Prioritize and Focus

quotes.quote:
Set and enforce an aspirational personal hourly rate. If fixing a problem will save less than your hourly rate, ignore it. If outsourcing a task will cost less than your hourly rate, outsource it.
设定一个大胆的个人时薪，并严格执行。如果解决一个问题节省的成本低于时薪，那就忽略问题；如果外包一项任务的成本低于时薪，那就选择外包。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Prioritize and Focus

quotes.quote:
Work as hard as you can. Even though who you work with and what you work on are more important than how hard you work.
工作时要拼尽全力，毫无保留。不过，共事的人和工作的内容比努力程度更重要。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Prioritize and Focus

quotes.quote:
Become the best in the world at what you do. Keep redefining what you do until this is true.
在自己选择的职业领域里做到全球顶尖。不断重新定义自己的事业，直到理想成为现实。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
There are no get-rich-quick schemes. Those are just someone else getting rich off you.
世界上没有快速致富的教程。即使有，那也只是提供教程的人想从你身上赚钱。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Prioritize and Focus

quotes.quote:
Apply specific knowledge, with leverage, and eventually you will get what you deserve.
运用专长，发挥杠杆效应，最终你会得到自己应得的。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
Your summary says “Productize yourself”
你的总结里写着“把自己产品化”。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Understand How Wealth Is Created

quotes.quote:
No one can compete with you on being you.
在“成为自己”这件事情上，没有人能比得过你。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find and Build Specific Knowledge

quotes.quote:
The best jobs are neither decreed nor degreed. They are creative expressions of continuous learners in free markets.
最好的工作与委任或学位无关。最好的工作是终身学习者在自由市场中的创造性表达。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find Work That Feels Like Play

quotes.quote:
All the returns in life, whether in wealth, relationships, or knowledge, come from compound interest.
生活中所有的回报，无论是财富、人际关系，还是知识，都来自复利。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Play Long-Term Games with Long-Term People

quotes.quote:
Intentions don’t matter. Actions do. That’s why being ethical is hard.
出发点并不重要，行为本身才重要。因此，遵守道德标准并非易事。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Take on Accountability

quotes.quote:
You’re never going to get rich renting out your time.
靠出租自己的时间是永远无法致富的。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Build or Buy Equity in a Business

quotes.quote:
Earn with your mind, not your time.
用头脑赚钱，而不是用时间赚钱。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Get Paid for Your Judgment

quotes.quote:
Wealth creation is an evolutionarily recent positive-sum game. Status is an old zero-sum game. Those attacking wealth creation are often just seeking status.
在人类进化史上，财富创造是近代才出现的活动，是一个正和游戏。而地位之争自古有之，是一个零和游戏。那些攻击财富创造的人往往只是为了追求地位。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Prioritize and Focus

quotes.quote:
I’m always “working.” It looks like work to others, but it feels like play to me. And that’s how I know no one can compete with me on it. Because I’m just playing, for sixteen hours a day.
我永远都在“工作”。但是，别人眼里的工作于我而言就像是玩耍。正因如此，我才确信没有人可以在我的领域与我匹敌。因为我觉 得工作就是玩耍，所以我可以一天玩16个小时。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: Find Work That Feels Like Play

quotes.quote:
Become the best at what you do. Refine what you do until this is true. Opportunity will seek you out. Luck becomes your destiny.
把你所做的事情做到极致。精益求精，直到名副其实。让机会 自动找到你，让运气成为必然。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Wealth, Section: How to Get Lucky

quotes.quote:
There’s no shortcut to smart.
真正聪明的人，从不走捷径。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Judgment

quotes.quote:
You don’t get rich by spending your time to save money. You get rich by saving your time to make money.
把时间花在省钱上是不会致富的。省出时间来赚钱才是正确的思路。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Judgment

quotes.quote:
Judgment. Judgment is underrated.
判断力。判断力被低估了。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Judgment

quotes.quote:
In an age of leverage, one correct decision can win everything.
在杠杆时代，一个正确的决策可以帮你赢得一切。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Judgment

quotes.quote:
Without hard work, you’ll develop neither judgment nor leverage.
不付出努力，就无法培养判断力，也不会获得任何杠杆。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Judgment

quotes.quote:
Being “smart” is overrated. The better compliment is “clear thinker.”
与“聪明”相比，“思路清晰”是一种更好的赞誉。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: How to Think Clearly

quotes.quote:
It’s only after you’re bored you have the great ideas. It’s never going to be when you’re stressed, or busy, running around or rushed. Make the time.
悠闲的大脑才能产生伟大的创意。一个倍感压力、案牍劳形、四处奔波、焦头烂额的人，是没有办法思考的。所以，一定要为思考挤出时间。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: How to Think Clearly

quotes.quote:
Very smart people tend to be weird since they insist on thinking everything through for themselves.
非常聪明的人往往都是特立独行的，他们坚持独立思考、亲力亲为，以厘清事情的来龙去脉。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: How to Think Clearly

quotes.quote:
A contrarian isn’t one who always objects—that’s a conformist of a different sort. A contrarian reasons independently from the ground up and resists pressure to conform.
逆向投资者并非总是反对一切，事实上，反对一切是墨守成规的另一种表现。逆向投资者会根据实际情况独立思考，能够顶住盲目从众的压力。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: How to Think Clearly

quotes.quote:
Cynicism is easy. Mimicry is easy. Optimistic contrarians are the rarest breed.
玩世不恭很容易，随波逐流也很容易。成为逆向投资的乐观主义者才最难得。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: How to Think Clearly

quotes.quote:
Tension is who you think you should be. Relaxation is who you are.
紧张是你认为的自己，放松是你本来的自己。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Shed Your Identity to See Reality

quotes.quote:
Any belief you took in a package (ex. Democrat, Catholic, American) is suspect and should be re-evaluated from base principles.
任何一个标签（比如“前民主党人”“天主教徒”“美国人”）都是一系列信仰、理念和身份的集合。我们应该秉持怀疑态度，从基本原则出发，对其重新评估。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Shed Your Identity to See Reality

quotes.quote:
To be honest, speak without identity.
要做到诚实，就要在发表观点时抛开自己的身份。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Shed Your Identity to See Reality

quotes.quote:
The classical virtues are all decision-making heuristics to make one optimize for the long term rather than for the short term.
传统美德对我们的决策具有很大的启发意义：要选择从长期来看让我们受益最大的做法，而不是只顾眼前得失。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn the Skills of Decision-Making

quotes.quote:
Self-serving conclusions should have a higher bar.
当把成功归于自己时，你要更加谨慎，因为难免出现认知偏差。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn the Skills of Decision-Making

quotes.quote:
I never ask if “I like it” or “I don’t like it.” I think “this is what it is” or “this is what it isn’t.”
我从不考虑“我喜欢或不喜欢”这样的问题。我只关注事实，我思考问题的角度是“事实就是这样”，或者“事实不是这样”。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn the Skills of Decision-Making

quotes.quote:
During decision-making, the brain is a memory prediction machine.
在决策的过程中，大脑是一台根据过往记忆进行预测的机器。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Collect Mental Models

quotes.quote:
The more you know, the less you diversify.
越觉得自己无所不知，规避和处置风险的方法越少。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Collect Mental Models

quotes.quote:
Mental models are really just compact ways for you to recall your own knowledge.
所谓的心智模型，其实就是有助于调取你所学知识的简单方法。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Collect Mental Models

quotes.quote:
I try to eliminate what’s not going to work. I think being successful is just about not making mistakes. It’s not about having correct judgment. It’s about avoiding incorrect judgments.
我认为自己并没有能力找到“正确方法”。相反，我努力的方向是逐一排除不奏效的方法。我认为成功就是不犯错。成功的关键并不在于做出正确判断，而在于避免做出错误判断。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Collect Mental Models

quotes.quote:
IF YOU CAN’T DECIDE, THE ANSWER IS NO.
如果难以抉择，那答案就是否定的
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Collect Mental Models

quotes.quote:
As you know, most of the gains in life come from suffering in the short term so you can get paid in the long term.
如你所知，我们生命中的大部分收获都来自承受短期痛苦而获得的长期回报。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Collect Mental Models

quotes.quote:
Reading science, math, and philosophy one hour per day will likely put you at the upper echelon of human success within seven years.
每天花一个小时阅读科学、数学和哲学类书籍，7年内，你就可能跻身少数的成功人士之列。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Collect Mental Models

quotes.quote:
The genuine love for reading itself, when cultivated, is a superpower. We live in the age of Alexandria, when every book and every piece of knowledge ever written down is a fingertip away. The means of learning are abundant—it’s the desire to learn that is scarce.
真心热爱阅读，加上后天的引导和培养，你的能力将不可限量。我们生活在亚历山大时代，只需要轻点指尖，任何图书和知识都唾手可得。我们学习的手段丰富多样，我们缺乏的是求知欲。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
I don’t actually read a lot of books. I pick up a lot of books and only get through a few which form the foundation of my knowledge.
我精读的书其实并不多。我会略读很多书，但精读的只有几本，而这几本书构成了我知识的基础。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
The reality is, I don’t actually read much compared to what people think. I probably read one to two hours a day. That puts me in the top .00001 percent. I think that alone accounts for any material success I’ve had in my life and any intelligence I might have.
事实上，我的阅读量并没有大家想象中那么大。我每天可能阅读一两个小时，不过这已经足够让我名列全球阅读时间的前0.000 01%了。阅读是我一生中所有物质和精神层面所取得的成就的来源。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
The number of books completed is a vanity metric. As you know more, you leave more books unfinished. Focus on new concepts with predictive power.
统计阅读数量是为了满足虚荣心。知识面越广，思想越独立，读不完的书就越多。不要刻意追求读完多少本书，而要时刻关注可以预测未来趋势的新概念。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
If they wrote it to make money, don’t read it.
如果一本书被写出来只是为了赚钱，那么不要读它。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
Explain what you learned to someone else. Teaching forces learning.
向别人讲解你学到的东西。教学相长。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
It’s not about “educated” vs. “uneducated.” It’s about “likes to read” and “doesn’t like to read.”
人与人的区别不是“受过教育”和“没受过教育”，而是“喜欢阅读”和“不喜欢阅读”。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
Study logic and math, because once you’ve mastered them, you won’t fear any book.
学习逻辑和数学。一旦掌握了逻辑和数学，无论读什么书你都不会发怵了。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
Because most people are intimidated by math and can’t independently critique it, they overvalue opinions backed with math/pseudoscience.
大多数人对数学都有一种天然的畏惧感，他们不能对数据进行独立评判，因此，在遇到以数学方法或伪科学为支撑的观点时，难免会高估这些观点的价值。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
If you’re a perpetual learning machine, you will never be out of options for how to make money. You can always see what’s coming up in society, what the value is, where the demand is, and you can learn to come up to speed.
如果能成为一台永动学习机，你就永远不缺赚钱的途径。你会拥有洞察社会现象本质的能力，你会找到真正的价值和需求所在，然后通过学习，紧跟时代发展的脚步。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
You know that song you can’t get out of your head? All thoughts work that way. Careful what you read.
你的脑海中是不是会偶尔出现一首歌曲的旋律，它总是挥之不去？这就是记忆痕迹。其实所有思想的形成莫不是痕迹效应的结果。所以要慎重选择阅读内容。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read

quotes.quote:
A calm mind, a fit body, and a house full of love. These things cannot be bought. They must be earned.
一颗平静的心，一个健康的身体，一个充满爱的家。这些东西是金钱买不到的，必须通过努力才能获得。
quotes.source: The Almanack of Naval Ravikant – Part 1: Wealth: On Building Judgment, Section: Learn to Love to Read
